correctness.rationale: Abrams deleted-product two-cell model for two distinct particles on K_{p,q}, p,q≥3, has basis e_ij×e_kl with i≠k,j≠l. Its four oriented boundary families impose precisely d_p⊗id and id⊗d_q zero-sum equations on ordered distinct-index pairs. The crown incidence kernel L_m is a direct summand of the free A_m for m≥3, so the simultaneous Z-kernel is canonically L_p⊗L_q, not merely a rational dimension count. Edge count m(m−1), vertices 2m gives rank m²−3m+1. Particle exchange changes cell product orientation by -1 and interchanges each ordered crown pair, yielding -T_p⊗T_q; balanced bipartition swap flips both edge orientations and interchanges lattice factors. Traces follow from the incidence exact sequence and the rank-one cokernel. The p=q=3 rank-one case and trace formulas provide independent boundary checks. Does not imply an equivariant homotopy splitting.
